landing.title: Self-driving money. The regulator holds the brakes.
landing.lede: An AI agent rebalances your gold, silver and dollars and pays your bills, inside a mandate that lives on-chain. A bank, a regulator and an operator hold the authority on FISCO BCOS.
pillar.autonomous.text: Inside its mandate the agent acts alone: rebalances back to your bands, pays your known payees.
pillar.bounded.text: Every call is checked on-chain by the Mandate hook. Anything outside asks you, with Face ID.
pillar.regulated.text: The consortium can freeze the agent with one signature; loosening needs two of three.
